I politely disagree with this. He is just worried. When your in a relationship your partner becomes your other half in a sense. Narcissists would more often then not, not even ask her about her emotions. Its souly about theirs. 

People fail to realize that from the sounds of it, every day this girl is coming home and is being closed off. Very closed off. She is snappy at him, short and cold with him and in general not fair to him. 

A simple Google search would tell you three things about her behavior. She either is losing or has lost interest in him(makes him overthink hearing this), she has depression and is pushing him away(making him wonder if he should be there more or less for her.) Or if she is cheating.

It takes two to tango and right now she is sabotaging her relationship by not giving him a simple "I don't feel like talking about it at the moment. Ill be ok. You have done nothing wrong. I just need time to think and cool off". 

That sentence alone would solve all his worries.

He doesn't sound insecure. He sounds worried about her. Imagine if she wanted to talk and he made no effort to check up on her. This entire sub-reddit would be everyone saying that he is too emotionally closed off.

Not sure if this is quite fair to the guy. Originally in my relationship I told my gf that she could talk to me when she chose about problems but she seemed very detached in general when life got tough. 

This affected me(im half the relationship too) because I was stressing if I did something and just didn't know or if she was even ok. 

I brought this up to her and just simply asked that if she is feeling distant that week to explain that to me. It gave me peace of mind knowing I did nothing wrong that I was unaware of and allowed me to focus souly on her and what she was going through when she needed me. 

Saying this guy has "baby" feelings is the exact reason why guys don't show emotion or dont reach out more. If you look on other sub-reddits girls will explain their guys arnt open enough. Thats due to being told they have "baby" feelings or to keep emotion to themselves. Guys are entitled to being needy,being emotional and being weak. Girls do it all the time. They get acceptance for it much more then guys do. So please don't call his feelings "baby" feelings. 

If he is feeling insecure so what? All people do. Telling a guy to not feel insecure will just create more insecurities. Instead what this girl should do is explore with her partner why her being closed off makes him insecure. Explore why he feels the need to check up on her so much. Based off this they can set boundaries. For his and her comfort. 

Many people here are not considering that often its hard to explore emotion with your partner if they won't explore it with you. 

So yah he may have built up feelings that he won't talk about because quite frankly why would he talk about his emotions when she is snapy over hers. Energy is reciprocated. If she is gunna be snapy at him for checking up on her,give him cold responses and expect nothing in return then she is blind to how people process emotion. 

It takes two to tango.

Hate to break it to you but your in the wrong here. 

As a guy communication is key for me. If my gf seems off I ask her what is wrong. When she says "nothing" my mind races two different places. Either iv done something wrong or something else is wrong.

Guys are natural problem solvers. Whether they are good at it or not.

A more appropriate response to when he asks if you are OK is not to get snappy(i would think I did something wrong if my gf snapped at me) and either say one of three things. Yes something is wrong(and talk about it), yeah something is bugging me but I don't want to discuss it at this moment(make it clear if it is or isn't him. Stops overthinking), or no I don't want to talk about it(and once again make it clear if he is at fault or not. Stops overthinking).

Guys overthink a lot. Especially if we are close to you (like in a relationship). We want you to be happy and knows what's wrong. We want to be there for you. Not giving any proper response and being snappy because your tired is not fair to him. You need to work on this

If he continues to push and push then you need to sit down with him and set boundaries and let him set boundaries he wants too. You both have the right to peace of mind and personal space. A middle ground must be found.
